narrativeBeat: CHANGE: one causal beat this page must show
locationId: CHANGE: exact locationId from story.json for this page — must match, it selects the location-sheet reference
primaryRequest: CHANGE: one drawable group action (name who does what)

inputImages.path: CHANGE: absolute persona-02 photo — only if on this page
CHANGE: absolute accepted character-sheet path after gate

participants.displayName: CHANGE Arabic name or omit if not on page

guests.displayName: CHANGE kid-facing alias (Arabic ok) — not the franchise English name
guests.canonicalHint: CHANGE optional private hint e.g. spider-man — NEVER copy into compiledPrompt
guests.appearanceNotes: CHANGE: detailed visual description only — costume colors, mask, silhouette, materials. NO real character name, NO logos, NO trademarks.

persona-01.face: match persona-01 photo exactly: same face structure, eyes, brows, nose, mouth, likeness
persona-01.hair: same hair color, length, style as reference

persona-02.face: match persona-02 photo exactly — never borrow persona-01 features
persona-02.hair: same hair color, length, style as reference

fixedOutfits.persona-01: CHANGE once in brief/story, reuse verbatim every page this person appears

spatialStaging: CHANGE when 2+ people: left/right/front positions, who faces whom, contact or distance

scene.timeOfDay: CHANGE: hour + light quality (e.g. soft golden morning, cool blue dusk)
scene.lighting: CHANGE: key light direction, color temperature, shadows soft/hard, rim/fill
scene.foreground: CHANGE: near objects with material, color, scale (must be drawable)
scene.midground: CHANGE: where action happens — surfaces, furniture, paths, plants
scene.background: CHANGE: far layer — sky, buildings, trees, horizon depth
propsInFrame: CHANGE: every visible prop with color + material + state
scene.backdropDetails: CHANGE: 3–6 concrete sensory details (textures, colors, small life)

persona-01.action: CHANGE: body pose, hands, gaze, weight shift — one clear moment

persona-02.action: CHANGE: complementary pose in same moment (not a second beat)

style.medium: CHANGE: paste from themes/catalog.json for brief.themeId (default storybook: premium whimsical children's storybook digital illustration, magical realism, soft painterly textures, cinematic multi-source lighting)
style.finish: CHANGE: paste from catalog for same themeId (default storybook: rich saturated color, detailed joyful faces, warm-cool light mix, print-ready, NOT flat cartoon, NOT clipart, NOT washed gouache)

composition.shotScale: CHANGE: wide|medium|close — must differ from adjacent pages
composition.viewpoint: CHANGE: eye-level|low|high — must differ from adjacent pages
composition.focalHierarchy: CHANGE: who/what eye hits first, second, third

textIntegration.placement: CHANGE: top|bottom|side — quiet zone in art, differ from adjacent pages
textIntegration.blendMode: CHANGE: painted-into-sky | soft-caption-band | chalk-on-surface | carved-sign | floating-letterforms matching palette
textIntegration.surface: CHANGE: what the Arabic sits on (sky wash, stone path, wooden beam, soft vignette band sharing scene colors)
textIntegration.legibility: high — readable at print size, never cropped, never colliding with faces/hands

text.verbatimArabic: CHANGE: exact string from story.json for this page
text.renderingRules: Render the quoted Arabic exactly once inside the illustration, right-to-left, correctly connected, fully legible, with no missing, added, reversed, mirrored, or substituted characters. Blend the lettering into the scene as part of the art — soft storybook typography that shares the page palette, lighting, and texture (gentle painted caption band, sky wash, or environmental surface). Do NOT use a hard white box, sticker label, speech bubble, or detached UI panel. Keep a quiet clear zone so faces and action stay unobstructed. Large simple Arabic display typeface. No Latin text.

palette: CHANGE once in story continuity, reuse with beat emphasis only

continuity.fromPreviousPage: CHANGE: props/outfit/state carried forward for each returning persona

constraints: exactly listed participants only — no extra people
each on-page persona matches their own photo identity lock (no face swap)
complete anatomy: hands, feet, faces uncropped unless intentional close-up
landscape full-bleed full-page illustration (wider than tall)
describe every visible layer: foreground, midground, background, props
Arabic text blended into the artwork, not a separate box
avoid: franchise character names in the image prompt
compiledPrompt: CHANGE: single final prompt string assembled from fields above for $imagegen
